ValidationRule.description: Date Closure Complete must be current or past date. It cannot be in the Future.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType_Name__c = "CAC - DP Closure" && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_Closure_Complete__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Closure_Complete__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_Closure_Complete__c) > TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_Closure_Complete__c)) || DATEVALUE(Date_Closure_Complete__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Date_Closure_Complete__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_Closure_Complete__c)) && DATEVALUE(Date_Closure_Complete__c) > TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date Closure Complete must be current or past date. It cannot be in the Future.
